summary: Tested new Offline Practices feature (download from Meditations -> IndexedDB -> playback with zero TTS network calls -> delete) and Sacred Journey widget on Dashboard. All backend endpoints (POST /api/practice-history, GET /api/practice-history, GET /api/practice-history/stats, POST /api/tts/generate-base64) pass. All frontend flows work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Data-source inconsistency (not a blocker): SacredJourneyWidget reads /api/practice-history/stats (practice_history collection only) — QA user shows 6 sessions/70 min/streak=1 in widget vs 47 sessions/1420 min/streak=7 on /progress dashboard which aggregates additional user_progress data. Consider unifying data source or documenting the difference so users are not confused when clicking 'Full progress'.

OfflinePractices.jsx line 68: URL.revokeObjectURL runs on stopPlayback but object URLs are also created lazily during playIndex; when previous segment finishes and next one starts, old URL remains referenced until stopPlayback. Not a leak in practice (whole array revoked on stop/unmount), just could revoke per-segment after audio.onended for tighter memory hygiene.

Meditations.jsx handleDownloadForOffline uses sequential await inside a for-loop — for large meditations (many chunks) this is slow; acceptable for MVP but consider small concurrency (Promise.allSettled batches of 2) to speed up user perception.
